summary: NextSync 0.2.4: Settings opens for zero-folder accounts, themed tray icon, trimmed tray menu, and Lucide-unified icons.
changelog: Settings now opens for accounts with no sync folders; desktop-integration switches are hidden when there is no folder (fixes the silent no-op).
The tray icon publishes a bare symbolic icon name resolved through the icon theme, so it follows the theme instead of rendering black.
The tray menu is trimmed to Open NextSync, Settings, and Quit; per-account submenu and redundant actions removed.
All shipped icons now come from Lucide (folder and symbolic variants replaced).
